chosen.title: The Lab That Runs Itself: How Autonomous Labs Are Compressing Materials Discovery From Years to Days
chosen.rationale: Self-driving labs crossed from demo to working infrastructure in the first half of 2026 -- C&EN ran a field survey in June 2026, Materials Horizons published a 'self-driving laboratory 2.0' review, and Argonne's Polybot is closing the design-run-analyze loop on electronic polymer films. It is squarely Kenji's primary beat (materials science, robotics, autonomous systems, clean energy) and is mechanism-rich rather than hype, which is what his readers come for.
